# Drone News 48h Brief — August 23, 2026

_Window: last 48 hours; 61 incidents._

## Summary
In the past 48 hours, a notable spike in drone-related incidents has emerged, particularly surrounding unauthorized flights over wildfires which pose serious operational risks—67 such incursions near wildfires were reported. Additionally, several incidents of drone strikes in Ukraine are alarming, with a Russian attack resulting in significant casualties. In the U.S., the NYPD is on high alert at the US Open, ready to neutralize unauthorized drones, reflecting an increasing emphasis on drone regulation. Reports of illegal drone activities aim to enhance border security, especially in New South Wales, while other operations have been thwarted, highlighting counter-drone measures against smuggling and attacks. Overall, there's a growing concern over national and public safety due to various malicious or negligent uses of drones.
